name: n6-refund-ledger-close-environment
description: Runtime for return case ledger entries and case closure.

tools.locate_return: Finds a return case and records return_found.
tools.process_refund_record: Requires return_found, records the refund ledger entry, and sets refund_recorded.
tools.close_case: Requires refund_recorded, closes the case, and records case_closed.
